title: fix(plugin-security): type explainAccessForCaller's request as the contract's ExplainAccessRequest
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-warren"} -->
_Requested by **Warren** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8?thread=cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8VXJ5hk8EG2fKt5gobE64M1)_
Fixes #29481

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:`SecurityPlugin#explainAccessForCaller` 的请求参数类型从内联的 `{ object; operation; userId?; recordId? }` 改为契约里的 `ExplainAccessRequest`,于是批量形态 `recordIds` 也在声明类型里了。
- 为什么改:方法体早已支持 `recordIds`,公开契约也已声明它,只有方法签名漏掉;类型化调用方想批量解释访问权限必须强转。
- 风险与回滚:纯类型改动,运行时零变化;回滚即撤回 `security-plugin.ts` 的一行签名与一个 import。
- 先看:`packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/security-plugin.ts`(签名与 import),`packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/explain-batch-parity.test.ts`(新增的类型钉与直调用例)。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-security typecheck`,预期退出 0;把签名改回旧的内联类型后同一命令出现 3 个错误(见 Verification)。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/security-plugin.ts`: `explainAccessForCaller(request: ExplainAccessRequest, callerContext?)`, importing the interface from `@objectstack/spec/contracts`. The body module (`security-plugin-explain-access.ts`) already reads `request.recordIds`; nothing else moves. `SecurityServiceHost['explainAccessForCaller']` is `SecurityPlugin['explainAccessForCaller']`, so the service host picks the contract type up with no edit.
- `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/explain-batch-parity.test.ts`: a new `describe` (item 3 of the file header, "THE TYPED DOOR"):
  - compile-time: `expectTypeOf` holds the method's first parameter equal to `ExplainAccessRequest`, with a `@ts-expect-error` control showing the matcher can fail (the selector without `recordIds` is a different type). Both are live: `tsconfig.test.json` compiles this file, and `check:test-typecheck` runs it from the package's `typecheck` script.
  - runtime: a typed caller passes `recordIds` as an object literal straight to `plugin.explainAccessForCaller` and gets exactly the answer the registered `security` service gives for the same batch.
  - `plugin` is lifted from a `beforeAll` local to a module binding so the case can call it.
- `.changeset/29481-explain-access-request-type.md`: `patch` for `@objectstack/plugin-security` (a published package; the method is public on the exported class).

## Why

The published `ExplainAccessRequest` gained `recordIds?: ExplainRequest['recordIds']` with #29297, and the body honours it, but the reference implementation's own method still declared a request without it. A typed caller of `SecurityPlugin.explainAccessForCaller` could not pass a batch without a cast, and the declared type disagreed with what the method honours.

## Tests

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-security test`: Test Files 241 passed (241), Tests 5202 passed, 45 skipped (5247), lock VERDICT command-exit 0 (run at ace94629; the later head eafb125f changes only the new test case, re-run below).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-security exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/explain-batch-parity.test.ts` at eafb125f: Test Files 1 passed (1), Tests 46 passed (46), exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-security typecheck` at eafb125f: exit 0; `check:test-typecheck: OK`, the test layer compiles under `tsconfig.test.json` with 0 errors.

## Acceptance notes

- No runtime change, so no ablation: the reverse verification below is the proof the pin can fail.
- The runtime case passes the request as an object literal on purpose, so the excess-property check would refuse `recordIds` against the old declared type.
